Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
The Job
We are looking for an AI Solution Architect to shape how AI solutions are designed and delivered across client 
engagements. You will connect business needs with practical AI architectures, stay hands-on through PoCs and 
technical reviews, and help engineering teams adopt AI-assisted development through coaching, reusable tools, and 
clear standards. 
Key Responsibilities 
Lead client discovery and solution workshops, assess AI use cases, and translate business needs into feasible technical approaches. 
Design secure, scalable, and cost-aware architectures using LLMs, RAG, agents, data integrations, and cloud services. 
Build or guide PoCs, review designs and code, and support critical technical decisions during delivery. 
Support solution scoping, technical proposals, presentations, and estimation for selected client opportunities. 
Lead AI enablement by coaching teams on AI-assisted development, coding agents, evaluation practices, and reusable engineering workflows. 
Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, governance principles, and success measures across AI projects. 
Your Skills and Experience
Must Have 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
6+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a related technical role, including recent hands-on Generative AI experience. 
Strong English communication, facilitation, presentation, and technical documentation skills. 
Personally built and delivered at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based application beyond the prototype stage. 
Working knowledge of RAG, vector search, agentic workflows, tool calling, model selection, and AI system limitations.
Experience designing cloud-based architectures, APIs, integrations, data flows, and CI/CD practices. 
Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, security, privacy, performance, and cost trade-offs. 
Experience using AI coding tools and the ability to coach engineers in practical AI-assisted software development. 
Client-facing experience in discovery, requirement translation, architecture presentations, and stakeholder communication.
Nice to Have 
Experience with technical presales, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, or delivery estimation. 
Multi-agent systems, MCP, knowledge graphs, multimodal AI, or document intelligence. 
Experience designing technical training, engineering standards, or reusable solution accelerators. 
Spec-driven development, AI governance frameworks, or relevant cloud and AI certifications.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Work Environment & Culture:
Engage with a youthful, dynamic team working on awesome projects applying cutting-edge technologies.
Gain global exposure by working alongside international specialists, providing a fantastic opportunity to expand your skill set.
A transparent, honest, and respectful culture that empowers individuals to reach their full potential.
Compensation & Health Benefits:
13th-month salary and highly attractive performance-based bonuses.
Premium accident and healthcare insurance plans, plus comprehensive annual health check-ups.
Allowances & Facilities:
Allowances for lunch, free parking, and life events (marriage, newborn baby, bereavement, etc.).
A spacious, fully equipped pantry (microwave, fridge, coffee maker, etc.) for your most comfortable lunch breaks.
Engagement & Recognition:
Diverse sports clubs and social activities (Badminton, Football, Yoga, Tech clubs).
Annual company teambuilding trips.
Engaging monthly internal events: Happy Gatherings, Mini Games, Team Birthdays, Year-End Party, etc.
Quarterly and yearly awards recognizing outstanding individuals, teams, and long-term dedication.
Advanced English and soft skill training programs to assist your career development.
Exclusive perk: Unique internal company supporting funds to help ease personal financial goals (Home, Vehicle, Tuition loans, etc.).
Supplemental skill tags (not requirements): LLM; Kubernetes; RAG; English
